title: Infer quant suggestor with robustness scores and staged rollouts
creator: Aisha Nakamura
description: Build an automated per-model quantization suggestion service that recommends FP8/INT8 defaults for the model catalog along with an explicit robustness score and guardrail checklist. The service will produce a primary suggested profile, a safe fallback profile, and a short rationale (cost vs quality tradeoffs). It must integrate with the calibration pipeline to run lightweight shadow validations and emit signals suitable for Console rollouts and Optimize recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Suggestor API returns {primary_profile, fallback_profile, robustness_score, rationale} for any catalog model. 2) Each suggestion has associated validation metrics (delta-perplexity, top-k accuracy shift, hallucination-rate proxy) from a shadow calibration run. 3) Console displays suggested profile and safety band; can trigger staged rollout with canary percent. 4) CI gate prevents promoting suggestions if robustness_score < 0.6 or if critical regression observed on golden prompts. 5) Documentation and example PRD + SDK sample added.
engineering_notes: Core components: 1) Inference profiler to collect activation ranges and PTQ-friendly stats (per-layer min/max, outlier count). 2) Calibration runner that executes small evaluation batches across representative datasets and the customer's fingerprint if available. 3) Robustness scoring model that combines accuracy deltas, token-level divergence, and worst-case prompt behaviour to produce 0..1 score. 4) Suggestor service with rule-based guardrails (e.g., for safety-sensitive models or long-sequence tasks prefer FP8 fallback). 5) Integrations: model-catalog metadata store, CI gating, Console UI hooks, and Optimize recommendations export.
validation_plan:
- Run shadow-calibration on 30 open models (mix of decoder-only, encoder-decoder, varying sizes).
- For each model run: FP32 baseline -> INT8 candidate -> FP8 candidate. Measure deltas on: perplexity, BLEU/ROUGE where applicable, token divergence (KL on logits), and hallucination proxy (entity hallucination checks).
- Compute robustness_score = weighted(accuracy_delta, kl_divergence, outlier_rate, perf_gain).
- Verify fallback profile recovers quality for >95% of prompts where primary profile regresses.
- Produce per-model calibration artifacts (csv) and attach to catalog metadata.
rollout_plan:
Phase 0: internal dogfood on infra models (2 weeks)
Phase 1: shadow rollout for 30 external customers (observability only, no traffic shift) (4 weeks)
Phase 2: opt-in canary for non-critical endpoints (1-5% traffic) with autoswitch to fallback on regression (6 weeks)
Phase 3: catalog-suggestor enabled as UI recommendation for customers with explanation cards (ongoing).
risks:
- FP8 instability on long context or attention-heavy layers can produce silent quality regressions.
- Dataset fingerprints might not represent customer workloads -> false positives/negatives.
- Calibration compute cost: running both FP8 and INT8 candidates increases CI cost.
- Over-reliance by users on the automated suggestion without running their own evals.
- Edge-case models (custom finetune or dense-specialized ops) may require manual overrides.
mitigations:
- Include a conservative fallback profile and automatic rollback triggers.
- Use sampling heuristics to pick representative calibration subsets to limit compute.
- Surface uncertainty bands and require explicit opt-in when uncertainty > threshold.
- Rate-limit automated suggestions and provide manual 'run full calibration' button.
